revision: S4 / P1 placement (2026-11-23, user: 32bit on the modules/usb-audio S5 carrier with an ESP32-S3 MCU board, two in / two out, two firmware pots + MODE, M3 standoffs as usb-audio). 6HP, two boards: carrier (jack board, 4 layers, the routed usb-audio S5 / R5 carrier adapted by hand) and the 32bit-mcu board (4 layers, usb-audio MCU board outline and strips) stacked on the carrier F side on 2.54 mm pin headers. The routed boards own placement.
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY for the carrier and the panel; the MCU board file uses mcu_kicad_origin_mm (8 mm less in Y, as the modules/usb-audio MCU board file it is drawn after). The carrier F side faces the panel; the MCU board sits on the carrier F side with its own F side facing the panel, so both KiCad top views equal the front view (no mirroring).

main_pcb.note: 29.0 x 110.0 mm carrier (modules/usb-audio S5). Held by the four jack nuts and the two M3x10 standoffs MS1/MS2; the MCU board hangs on it.

mcu_pcb.note: 29.0 x 29.55 mm, the modules/usb-audio MCU board outline and strip positions. 4 layers (F parts + signal, In1 GND, In2 +3V3, B signal; USB pair over In1). All SMD on F (one assembly side), facing the panel, below the two standoffs.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = carrier F.Cu, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.note: PJ301M-12 boss top = panel rear (as modules/8bit/32bit).
stack_Z_mm.usbc_note: USB-C needs its mouth no more than ~0.3 mm behind the panel front or the plug cannot seat (receptacle depth 6.20 mm vs plug shell 6.51-6.65 mm). HRO TYPE-C-31-D-15 (8.8 mm) on a 1.6 mm MCU board on 2.5 mm header plastic puts it 1.3 mm proud; the same land takes D-15A..D (9.3/10/10.5/12.4 mm). A 1.0 mm MCU board would make it 0.7 mm proud.

layout_note: User 2026-11-23: modules/usb-audio S5 P2 layout kept: columns X8.0 / X22.0, rows IN1 Y54.0, IN2 Y69.0 (jack left, pot right), OUT1 Y94.5, OUT2 Y109.5 (LED / MODE button left, jack right). The power header J1 stands upright at the left edge between the pairs. The MCU board takes Y18-47.55 with the USB-C at X15 Y24; MS1/MS2 stand above it at Y13.75.

usb_slot.note: Obround NPTH slot for the receptacle shell (8.94 x 3.16 mm, centre X15 Y24): 0.27 mm above and ~1.77 mm below the shell, as on the built modules/usb-audio-max and modules/multi-mix panels (slot extended 1.5 mm downwards); the shell passes through and stands 1.3 mm proud.

back_side_parts.band: Eurorack power, upright at the left edge between the IN2 jack and the OUT1 pot. THT, B side; pin 1 / 2 (-12 V) at the bottom

power_header.orientation: Upright at the left edge, pin 1 / 2 (-12 V) at the bottom row, +12 V at the top.
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the bottom); positions 11-16 overhang upward over the IN2 jack tails (TN, S at X8), 2.5 mm above B. SMD under it must stay below 2.5 mm. F side: the header tails sit between the IN2 jack S pad (0.52 mm) and the OUT1 pot body (0.5 mm). R4 check: only D1 / D2 (SOD-123, <= 1.35 mm) and the pin row of U2 (SOT-223, <= 1.8 mm) reach into the envelope (X7.8..8.47).

mount_standoffs.hardware: per standoff: 1 x M3 F-F hex standoff 10 mm (user stock), 2 x M3x6 pan/button head (ISO 7380), as modules/4mix. Not M3x8.
mount_standoffs.note: As modules/usb-audio P2 (user 2026-11-23: 'add the M3 screws for strength just like in the new USB Audio'): two M3 10 mm hex standoffs above the MCU board, so USB plug forces go into the panel and not into the J6/J7 solder joints. Carrier F to panel rear is 10 mm (stack_Z_mm), so each standoff is coaxial: carrier hole = panel hole. Y13.75 is as high as the 1 mm edge keep-out allows; the hex corners (R3.18) end at Y16.93, 1.07 mm above the MCU board edge (Y18.0).

button.part: Generic 6 x 6 mm THT tact switch, 4 pins, 7 mm tall (3.5 mm round stem), pins 6.5 x 4.5 mm (as modules/8bit SW1)
button.note: MODE (firmware-defined), in the former usb-audio RV4 spot; pads centred on XY. As 32bit S3 / modules/16bit: the mechanical/button-cap plunger reaches the panel.

leds.note: 3 mm red THT, in the former usb-audio RV3 spot, above the MODE button; pads centred on XY.
